# Testimoni

> Testimoni is a testimonial tool for solo founders and small SaaS teams (also used by coaches, agencies and D2C brands). Paste any X or LinkedIn URL and get an approved testimonial in 30 seconds — no screenshots, no copy-paste. Or share a link, form, or QR code to collect fresh testimonials. Every workspace gets a public Wall of Love URL and a one-line JavaScript embed on day one.

## What Testimoni is

Testimoni turns customer praise into social proof you can put anywhere. Three-step loop:

- **Ask** — Send one link (email, WhatsApp, DM, QR, or a widget on your site) to your happiest customers.
- **Collect** — Text, star ratings, and video (1 free on every plan) land in one approval inbox.
- **Publish** — One line of JavaScript embeds a Wall of Love on your site. Every workspace also gets a free hosted URL: `testimoni.io/w/<workspace-id>`.

Site: https://testimoni.io

## Pricing

- **Free forever**: 10 testimonials, 1 collection form, 1 widget, 1 video testimonial, hosted Wall of Love URL, one-line embed, grid layout. No credit card.
- **Pro — $19/month, flat (USD)**: Unlimited testimonials, forms, widgets, and video. All 5 layouts (Grid, Masonry, Carousel, List, Marquee). Custom branding. Remove "Powered by" watermark. Analytics dashboard. AI features included: Ask My Wall chatbot, Wall Score, tweet drafts, case study generator. Auto-sync from the App Store, Chrome Web Store, Play Store and Product Hunt. No yearly plan yet; no per-seat fees; cancel anytime.
- **Customer Voice report (one-time, separate from the subscription)**: the scan is free; Quick Scan $9 unlocks every mention; Deep Report $19 adds why customers choose a product, strongest social proof, competitors mentioned and a CSV export.

Prices last verified 28 Oct 2026.

## Comparison

Testimoni compared with other testimonial tools. Competitor details are described only as each company describes itself; check their sites for current plans and pricing.

- **vs Senja** — Testimoni offers a free hosted Wall of Love, paste-a-URL import, and Pro at $19/month flat (Senja's paid plans are $29 and $59 per month on its pricing page, checked 28 Oct 2026). Includes a plain summary of what Senja is. See [/vs/senja](https://testimoni.io/vs/senja).
- **vs Testimonial.to** — Testimoni is focused on testimonials and social proof, with a free hosted wall, paste-a-URL import, and Pro at $19/month flat. Testimonial.to describes itself as a broader platform (testimonials, case studies, NPS, brand monitoring). See [/vs/testimonial-to](https://testimoni.io/vs/testimonial-to).
- **vs Famewall** — Famewall's Standard plan is $12/month, cheaper than Testimoni Pro; Testimoni is one flat $19 plan built around importing praise by link. See [/vs/famewall](https://testimoni.io/vs/famewall).
- **vs Shapo** — Shapo Pro is $29/month; both have free plans. See [/vs/shapo](https://testimoni.io/vs/shapo).
- **Senja alternatives** — [/senja-alternatives](https://testimoni.io/senja-alternatives)
- **Best testimonial tools in 2026, compared** — [/blog/best-testimonial-tools](https://testimoni.io/blog/best-testimonial-tools)
- **All comparisons** — [/vs](https://testimoni.io/vs)

## Who Testimoni is for

- SaaS founders wanting a testimonial wall live in 30 seconds
- Coaches and creators building social proof from happy replies
- Agencies collecting client feedback for case studies
- D2C brands running QR-code testimonial collection on packaging
- Solo indie hackers who don't want to code a wall from scratch

## Key features

- **Paste-a-tweet import** — X and LinkedIn URLs pull the author, avatar, text, and star rating automatically
- **Collection forms** — public forms shareable via link, embed, iframe, email, or QR code
- **Video testimonials** — MP4/MOV upload; 1 free on every plan
- **Approval inbox** — one-click approve; approved testimonials flow to the Wall of Love instantly
- **5 layouts** — Grid, Masonry, Carousel, List, Marquee
- **One-line embed** — sub-10KB, Shadow-DOM isolated, no CSS conflicts with your site (Framer, Webflow, WordPress, React, plain HTML)
- **Hosted Wall of Love URL** — free public page on every plan
- **Auto-generated share tools** — QR code, email template, DM template

## Free tools (no signup required)

- [/tools](https://testimoni.io/tools) — index of all free testimonial tools
- [/tools/customer-voice](https://testimoni.io/tools/customer-voice) — paste a product URL to find public customer mentions and sort them into praise, complaints, feature requests, use cases, testimonials, outcomes and competitor mentions. The scan is free; the full evidence report is a one-time purchase
- [/tools/find-my-proof](https://testimoni.io/tools/find-my-proof) — free search for public praise about a product across X, Reddit, LinkedIn, Product Hunt and blogs
- [/tools/testimonial-card](https://testimoni.io/tools/testimonial-card) — testimonial card image generator (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram formats)
- [/tools/praise-tweet-finder](https://testimoni.io/tools/praise-tweet-finder) — smart X search URL builder for finding praise tweets about your @handle
- [/tools/testimonial-writer](https://testimoni.io/tools/testimonial-writer) — generate 3 testimonial variations from a name + short description
- [/tools/ask-templates](https://testimoni.io/tools/ask-templates) — copy-paste templates for asking customers for testimonials via WhatsApp, email, DM, LinkedIn, or SMS
- [/tools/linkedin-recommendation](https://testimoni.io/tools/linkedin-recommendation) — write a LinkedIn recommendation in 30 seconds with 3 versions to choose from
- [/tools/star-badge](https://testimoni.io/tools/star-badge) — design a star rating badge for your website (SVG download + embed code)
